name: look A
note: The reference colours of the player's look A (docs/harmony/ASSET_BRIEF.md §8: light skin, auburn ponytail, green coat with a darker teal trim and collar, a pink flower, round brown-framed glasses, a brown leather satchel strap, a black-lacquer brush) for tools/harmony_keyify.mjs (docs/harmony/contract/CONTRACT.md §5.5). The material ramps are the game's own ramps for the game look below (skin 1, auburn hair, cloth #4e7a4a / #3c5e38 with the trim #2e6a6e — no shipped outfit has this trim — and the flower channel's default), built as src/ui/88_harmony_raster.js builds them; tones dark to light, pick = the tones the key shades s0..s4 take. The fixed colours are generic starting points, not measured from any art: derive the delivery's own with --sample (a style master and a rough mask) or edit them. Lips follow the skin family (as: lips → skin), as the brief asks ("all skin (blush and lips too)"), so a darker skin gets darker lips, as the code busts do. The trim is painted teal by choice: only the painting colour, well clear of the brass; the game recolours it to the look's own trim. Robin's approved paired master (2026-10-04) shows the trim gold, which is the game's outfit 2 (#d8b060), and that is how look A appears in battle. A gold painting colour was tried: its ramp (#864129 → #e6deae) runs into the auburn hair, the brass and the light skin, and the keyify tests fail with it, so the layers paint the trim teal.
